rationale: Ground truth contains no inline comments and its only substantive concern (splitting out a VoxCPM2 regression fix) is unrelated to the visible 2-line diff and missed by both candidates, so recall is low for both. Both produce well-grounded, plausible findings about the seed removal's downstream effects (red CI lanes touching this yaml, missing tombstone comment, missing regression test) with comparable precision. Y edges ahead by adding a further well-cited finding about vLLM's own stage-0 sampler fast-path being affected and, crucially, supplies copy-pasteable code for its suggested yaml comment and regression test, making it more concretely actionable than X's descriptive-only suggestions.
